svg.title: F23 Electric starting circuit: battery, fuses, switches, interlocks, starter relay, starter motor and starter clutch
svg.text: Detail: starter drive and one-way clutch
Heavy starter current (orange, thick) flows only when the relay closes; the control current through the coil is under 1 A.
The one-way clutch locks the driven gear to the crankshaft while the motor turns it and overruns once the engine fires.
